fields.name: slots_home
fields.meaning: Three save slots for the home game, 300 (0x12C) bytes each: slot n (shown as 1-3) at n*0x12C. Rows below describe one slot at base 0x0000
fields.evidence: save writer/compare/load code (f000:c756/c6b4/c812/c8b6); saves seen in slots 1 and 2

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Slot-in-use marker: ASCII 'namco myangel ' with trailing space. Deleting a slot only zeroes its first two bytes
fields.evidence: copied from ROM at save time; compared word by word when listing/loading; delete zeroes word 0 (f000:c756/c6b4/c670)

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the 142 little-endian words at slot+0x10..slot+0x12B (link-play slots add the 26 words of their extra block)
fields.evidence: sum computed at save (f000:c704) and recomputed/compared at load (f000:c812); recomputed independently on all 132 save images holding data: every used slot matches

fields.name: file_id
fields.meaning: Two random numbers drawn when the family is created; identify the file and never change
fields.evidence: two calls to the random-number routine at creation (c000:1d8a/1d92 via 6000:0538); identical in all three saves of one playthrough

fields.name: age
fields.meaning: Daughter's age in years, shown as N才 in the slot list and on screen; +1 per year-end once progress bit 0 is set
fields.evidence: slot list renders it as decimal (f000:bfda); year-end increment (f000:8108); saves at 0, 1 and 2 with matching screens

fields.name: mode_flags
fields.meaning: Bit 0: link-play mode, selects slots 4-6 and the extra blocks. Bit 1: link companion flag, set together with bit 0. Bit 2: character-creation variant (start age 3 with this bit; picks an alternate portrait set). Other bits unseen
fields.evidence: slot math tests bit 0 (f000:c756/c812/c8b6); bits 0+1 set together when link play is chosen (c000:2b9c); bit 2 set at creation (6000:7e02) and read by the portrait loader (6000:0228); 0 in all saves

fields.name: family_name
fields.meaning: Family name, 5 characters of one 16-bit game text code each (0 = あ, 0xFFFC = blank)
fields.evidence: blanked at creation (c000:1916); slot list shows it first (reads at f000:c05f); all-zero names display as あああああ

fields.name: daughter_name
fields.meaning: Daughter's name, same coding
fields.evidence: same handling; slot list shows it second (reads at f000:c07f)

fields.name: papa_name
fields.meaning: Father's name, same coding
fields.evidence: blanked together with the other names in this order; entered on the naming screen

fields.name: mama_name
fields.meaning: Mother's name, same coding
fields.evidence: blanked together with the other names in this order; entered on the naming screen

fields.name: birth_day
fields.meaning: Birthday: day of month (entry cursor + 1)
fields.evidence: writer (c000:10d9); value 1 with a 1月1日 birthday on screen

fields.name: birth_month_blood
fields.meaning: Low 4 bits: birth month 1-12 (entry cursor + 1). High 4 bits: blood type (0 = A; only A seen)
fields.evidence: month writer (c000:10bf) and blood writer (c000:1194); month-1 indexes the days-per-month table for the day clamp; screen shows 1月, A型

fields.name: hearts
fields.meaning: Hearts left in the current quiz round; one lost per wrong answer
fields.evidence: wrong-answer path decrements it (e000:0035); new game sets 6; value 1 after 5 logged wrong answers, 6 at round start

fields.name: hearts_max
fields.meaning: Hearts at the start of a round
fields.evidence: new game writes 0x0606 (f000:57d0); always 6 in saves

fields.name: personality_type
fields.meaning: Personality type 0-15 shown under the portrait (0 = newborn, 1 = セクシーなまじめ, 15 = ねっからわんぱく); recomputed at year end from stat ratios
fields.evidence: 16 outcome sites (e000:0f74-10a6) fed by the trait ranking; captions on the status screen

fields.name: last_event
fields.meaning: Active special-event number minus 0x18; selects the event portrait and is copied into album records. 0xFFFF = none
fields.evidence: event recorder (f000:a2da); portrait selector uses it when set (6000:0228); album copy (f000:7b47); always 0xFFFF in saves

fields.name: stage_count_b
fields.meaning: Rounds started (+1 at every round setup). Equals the stage counter in every save; mid-round it leads by one
fields.evidence: round-start increment (f000:7f66); values 0/2/3 matching the stage counter

fields.name: event_flags
fields.meaning: Event record flags: bit 0 event number >= 0x10, bit 1 >= 0x14, bit 2 first visit, bit 3 repeat visit
fields.evidence: event recorder bit sets (f000:a2e8-a303); 0 in all saves

fields.name: stat_majime
fields.meaning: Personality score まじめ (serious)
fields.evidence: season gains added from tally (e000:10da); values 10 then 7 across saves; status-screen bar

fields.name: stat_iroke
fields.meaning: Personality score いろけ (charm)
fields.evidence: season gains (e000:10e1); values 10 then 7

fields.name: stat_otaku
fields.meaning: Personality score おたく (geeky)
fields.evidence: season gains (e000:10e8); rose 0 to 5 after an おたくUP answer

fields.name: stat_wanpaku
fields.meaning: Personality score わんぱく (naughty)
fields.evidence: season gains (e000:10ef); rose 5 to 14 after わんぱくUP answers

fields.name: stat_humanities
fields.meaning: Knowledge score 人文かがく (humanities)
fields.evidence: season gains (e000:10f6); values 5 then 4

fields.name: stat_social
fields.meaning: Knowledge score 社会かがく (social science)
fields.evidence: season gains (e000:1104); rose 5 to 14

fields.name: stat_nature
fields.meaning: Knowledge score しぜんかがく (natural science)
fields.evidence: season gains (e000:10fd); rose 5 to 19

fields.name: unused_58
fields.meaning: Always 0; only the new-game routine writes it
fields.evidence: new game writes 0 (f000:583a); no other writer or reader found; 0 in all saves

fields.name: judgment
fields.meaning: 判断力 (judgment) points, shown as stars
fields.evidence: season gain from the high byte of the judging tally (e000:110b); new game 1; values 1/3/8

fields.name: intelligence
fields.meaning: 知力 (intelligence) points, shown as stars
fields.evidence: season gain from the low byte of the judging tally (e000:1118); new game 1; values 1/4/9

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Child-rearing money in yen, capped at 999999
fields.evidence: quiz winnings/10 added (d000:08c7) with a 999999 cap (d000:08eb); shop price subtracted (f000:b768); screen-matched 11875/15311/13311/4060

fields.name: power_on_flags
fields.meaning: Small status flags (bits 0-1); cleared at every power-on
fields.evidence: cleared at reset (f000:56d4); bits tested/set by quiz/shop code (d000:ea92-eabe); 0 in all saves

fields.name: stage
fields.meaning: Round counter since birth, +1 at round end; 27 (0x1B) is the final stage
fields.evidence: round-end increment and 0x1B compare (e000:0d86); values 0/2/3

fields.name: missed_count
fields.meaning: Entries used in the missed-question list (max 35)
fields.evidence: append capped at 0x23 (e000:0061); values 0 then 5

fields.name: missed_questions
fields.meaning: Up to 35 quiz question numbers answered wrongly (first missed_count entries valid)
fields.evidence: wrong-answer handler stores the current question number (e000:0052); five entries shared by the two later saves

fields.name: progress_flags
fields.meaning: Progress flags; bit 0 is set at the first year end and gates yearly aging
fields.evidence: year-end test/set (f000:8108); values 0 then 1

fields.name: album
fields.meaning: Album: 31 records of 4 bytes, 0xFFFFFFFF = empty. Record: personality type OR scene flags, last-event byte, age at recording
fields.evidence: record writer (f000:7b34); new game fills 0xFF; first record after the opening (00 FF 00 00), second added by the picture-book scene at age 1 (F1 FF 01 00)

fields.name: slots_link
fields.meaning: Second group of three slots (4-6) at 0x0384 + n*0x12C, same layout; used in link play
fields.evidence: slot index + 3 when the mode bit is set (f000:c756/c812/c8b6); empty in all saves

fields.name: link_extra
fields.meaning: Three extra blocks of 0x34 bytes (one per link-play slot) at 0x0708 + n*0x34; saved alongside the slot and checksummed
fields.evidence: copied at save/load and included in the sum (f000:c756/c704/c812/c8b6); empty in all saves

fields.name: link_work
fields.meaning: Live link-play block kept in SRAM while playing (per-age data, read indexed by age at season end); copied out at save time
fields.evidence: zeroed at new game; read at e000:1142; summed into the checksum; empty in all saves

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never touched by the game; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in all 173 save images; no code reference found

fields.name: console_history_order
fields.meaning: Console-wide list of recently played cartridges (order numbers), updated at every power-on; not game progress
fields.evidence: power-on registration (f000:e800); changes 00 00.. to 00 06.. at first boot, then stable

fields.name: gap_0x07
fields.meaning: Not written by this game (zero)
fields.evidence: zero in all states

fields.name: console_history_entry
fields.meaning: This cartridge's entry in the console-wide history: tag word 1, then 10 ROM id bytes; written at power-on if missing; not game progress
fields.evidence: power-on registration copies ROM bytes (f000:e800) and files the entry

fields.name: console_history_other
fields.meaning: Room for the other six history entries (12 bytes each); empty here
fields.evidence: history driver addresses entry n at word 6n; zero in all states

fields.name: owner_info
fields.meaning: Console owner name/birthday area kept by the console; read only
fields.evidence: no game write; identical in all states

args.value: fix only supports 32 KiB SRAM images
